'''Holocloaks''' were elaborate [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] worn during festivities in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. Some attendees of the [[Unification Gala]] wore holocloaks.<ref name="ES">{{WEGCite|story=The Event of the Season|book=Tapani Sector Instant Adventures}}</ref>
